title: Cross-validation review: py/rs/c parity vs slot-claim COSE vectors
description:
Final review gate for the GCP-6.5 slot-claim fix: verify Python/Rust/Zephyr parity against the new vectors and that nothing of the old model remains. Cross-ref qpco.5 (general COSE parity); this child scopes the parent-bead-specific security properties.

Checks (run each implementation against test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.json from the vectors child):
1. Python: python/src/lichen/gateway/slot_claim.py migrated by qpco.1/.6/.7/.9 — old model gone: string-keyed to_cbor_map (:129-142), raw-map signing encode_claim_canonical/verify_slot_claim (:196-253) replaced by COSE_Sign1 with SHA256(CBOR(Sig_structure)); no expiry/claim_seq-less claims accepted. Cases 2 (slots mutation), 3 (replay), 4 (expiry boundary), 5 (alg decoy), 7 (ordinal absent) all pass with expected outcomes.
2. Rust: rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs migrated by qpco.2 — transcript-based signing retired for /slots claims (verify_gateway_message at :532, verify_slot_replay_seal at :794-800 either removed for this path or remapped onto the COSE + NV high-water design); replay high-water behavior matches case 3 semantics (reject <=, persist-before-apply).
3. Zephyr C: host CMake tests (lichen/tests/) green with ASan/UBSan for decode+verify+replay children; cppcheck clean (scripts/lint-c.sh); clang-tidy if available.
4. Cross-impl byte parity: for each positive vector, all three implementations produce/accept the identical COSE_Sign1 bytes and reject identical negatives (record a parity table in the bead comments).
5. Sibling bead project-LICHEN-worker6-mx8y closure evidence: no has_signature references repo-wide; silent-discard path (coap_slot_coord.c:1020-1024) logs at WARN with rate limiting; response codes are 2.04 accepted / 4.09 conflict-with-claim-payload / 4.03 expired+replay+invalid-slots per amended spec.
6. Old-model vectors test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim.json + gcp6_slot_coordination.json retired or re-homed with a deprecation note once parity is proven.

Acceptance criteria:
- Parity table posted as a comment on this bead: rows = vector cases, columns = py/rs/c, cells pass/fail with command evidence.
- All three implementations accept every positive and reject every negative vector.
- No usage of the old 3-field transcript ("SLOT_CLAIM:%02X:...") or has_signature remains in any implementation.
- Quality gates green: python pytest for gateway slot_claim module, cargo test -p lichen-gateway, C ctest with sanitizers.
- Findings filed as beads (discovered-from this bead) rather than fixed silently; this bead closes only when zero failing cells remain.
